locale_config.description:
Explicit, per-surface language and ordered font plans. This is part of
the executable identity; older executables without it are rejected.

modules.description: Immutable module interfaces; bodies and text bundles may be absent until prepared.

oneOf.description: A finite stop operation; completion is separate from natural playback end.

builtin_navigation.description:
Authors can reserve the complete page for source controls. Shared
Escape/right-click and preparation-failure exits remain available.

story_exports.description: Explicit read-only aliases of bounded story scalars. Never UI write targets.

oneOf.description: Finite vertical layout of declared, visible direct children.

MenuElement.description: Finite declarative menu content. All geometry uses the authored stage space.

MenuImageStates.description: Explicit image states for a finite scrollbar part. No runtime sprite slicing.

MenuSlot.description: A bounded save slot, either literal or selected by a local integer.

MenuValue.description: UI-local data never aliases VM variables or snapshot slots.

ThemeSlots.description:
Closed component registry implemented by the locked player SDK. Components
only project state; their actions and focus semantics remain player-owned.

TweenTarget.description: Typed property addresses. UI-owned objects are deliberately not addressable by Story.

oneOf.description: Freeze remaining audible voice duration at the beginning of the Auto cycle.
Reading delay starts once the bound voice is no longer running.
Reading delay and bound voice run concurrently; both must complete.
